source:
N = 6
BASE = 0x10
; เติมตาราง: x, 2x, 3x, … (ตัดเหลือ 8 บิต)
        LOAD A, [SW]
        MOV B, A
        MOV C, BASE
fill:   STORE [C], A
        ADD A, B
        ADD C, 1
        CMP C, BASE + N
        JNZ fill
; bubble sort: N - 1 รอบ
        MOV D, N - 1
pass:   MOV C, BASE
inner:  LOAD A, [C]
        ADD C, 1
        LOAD B, [C]
        CMP B, A
        JC noswap         ; B >= A เรียงถูกแล้ว
        STORE [C], A
        SUB C, 1
        STORE [C], B
        ADD C, 1
noswap: CMP C, BASE + N - 1
        JNZ inner
        SUB D, 1
        JNZ pass
        MOV C, BASE
show:   LOAD A, [C]
        STORE [OUT], A
        ADD C, 1
        CMP C, BASE + N
        JNZ show
        HALT
